review.finding: Fontkit's June 18, 2022 adaptation explicitly names this upstream project. The January 22, 2022 upstream 1.0.2 source contains the same alphabet/lookup, padding-length logic and three output-byte expressions. Fontkit renames variables and returns Uint8Array rather than ArrayBuffer; these are derived sources, not claimed byte-identical. The upstream full copyright/permission text is retained for that inherited code only.
review.remaining: No full project-level permission/copyright text for fontkit 2.0.4 is established. No substitute notice from another fontkit fork is adopted and no whole-package or distribution clearance is granted.
